# Flux

> Flux is an open-source (MIT), self-hostable media workspace: paste a link, choose MP4 or MP3, and save it offline. Node.js + yt-dlp + FFmpeg back end, plain ES-module front end with no build step and only two runtime dependencies. AI-assisted contributions are welcome.

Flux supports 15 source families (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, SoundCloud, Vimeo, Twitch, Reddit and more), genuine FFmpeg-validated 50% guest previews, Google sign-in (server-side OAuth with PKCE) for full downloads, an SSRF-safe egress proxy, owner-scoped job queue and history, and WCAG-checked responsive UI.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/10k11/flux/blob/main/README.md): features, screenshots, setup, configuration, architecture, API
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/10k11/flux/blob/main/AGENTS.md): code map, commands, hard rules and workflow for AI coding agents
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/10k11/flux/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): human contributor guide
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/10k11/flux/blob/main/SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting

## Contribute

- [Good first issues](https://github.com/10k11/flux/labels/good%20first%20issue)
- [Help wanted](https://github.com/10k11/flux/labels/help%20wanted)
- Workflow: fork, branch, PR to `main`; CI (`npm run check`, `format:check`, `test`) must pass.

## Key source files

- [server.mjs](https://github.com/10k11/flux/blob/main/server.mjs): routing, job queue, rate limits, file delivery
- [lib/auth.mjs](https://github.com/10k11/flux/blob/main/lib/auth.mjs): OAuth, sessions, CSRF
- [lib/egress.mjs](https://github.com/10k11/flux/blob/main/lib/egress.mjs): SSRF-safe proxy
- [lib/media.mjs](https://github.com/10k11/flux/blob/main/lib/media.mjs): yt-dlp arguments and validation
- [public/](https://github.com/10k11/flux/tree/main/public): front end
